convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom to load the FineTuningMA custom indicator, and relies on TradeAlgorithms.mqh external library for position open/close logic and money management. Custom indicator source not available in standard MT5.

derived_values.name: TimeShiftSec - seconds per indicator timeframe bar
min_rates_total - minimum bars required for indicator warmup

other_exits: Opposite signal closes existing position: bearish FineTuningMA crossover closes longs, bullish crossover closes shorts, gated by BuyPosClose/SellPosClose input booleans

position_sizing.conditional_logic: MarginMode enum selects sizing method: LOT=fixed lot, FREEMARGIN/BALANCE/LOSSFREEMARGIN/LOSSBALANCE=fraction of deposit. Default MM=0.1 with MMMode=LOT means 0.1 lots fixed. If MMMode is non-LOT, MM is interpreted as fraction of the selected margin base.

custom_logic_notes: The FineTuningMA indicator is a triple-rank, triple-shift weighted moving average with configurable applied price. Entry logic requires two conditions: (1) FineTuningMA[1] vs FineTuningMA[2] determines trend direction (rising=long bias, falling=short bias), and (2) FineTuningMA[0] vs FineTuningMA[1] confirms momentum continuation (current > previous for long, current < previous for short). SignalBar input offsets which bar is used for the primary signal (default=1, meaning the last completed bar). The BuyPosOpen/SellPosOpen/SellPosClose/BuyPosClose booleans act as independent gate toggles for each trade direction and action. GlobalVariableDel_ in OnDeinit cleans up a global variable used by TradeAlgorithms.mqh to track position opening times.
python_conversion_notes: Requires porting FineTuningMA custom indicator logic or pre-computing its values externally. TradeAlgorithms.mqh must be examined for BuyPositionOpen/SellPositionOpen/SellPositionClose/BuyPositionClose implementations to replicate exact order placement, margin calculation, and global variable tracking. The MarginMode enum and MM parameter interaction needs careful handling: when MMMode=LOT, MM is treated as fixed lot size; otherwise MM is a fraction of margin/balance. SL/TP of 1000/2000 points likely need digit-adjustment for 5-digit brokers (divide by 10 to get 100/200 pips). No trailing stop or grid logic simplifies conversion.
